repository_source_update.details: Checks git status in srcDir, fetches origin/main, checks for new commits

isolated_staging_build.details: Creates detached worktree in src-staging and builds in build-staging, leaving production srcDir untouched

cuda_sm75_build.details: Builds via CMake with -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=75 and MSVC BuildTools vcvars64

mtp_support_handling.details: Validates using --spec-type mtp:n_max=3,p_min=0.0 on test port 18080 and verifies draft_n_accepted

preservation_of_production_binary.details: Production bin/ is never modified until staging passes 100% of compile, load, and benchmark gates

versioned_backup.details: Mirrors production bin/ to backups/ik_llama/<timestamp>-<commit>/ with metadata JSON

automatic_rollback.details: Invokes rollback-ik-llama.ps1 if final smoke test fails after promotion

failed_build_handling.details: Cleans worktree and staging directories, records BUILD_FAILED in last_run_status.json, preserves production

station_stopped_requirement.details: Calls stop.ps1 and terminates file-locking processes before bin replacement

atomic_promotion.details: Promotes via Fast-CopyDir -Mirror from staging-bin to prod bin and writes BUILD-INFO.txt

defects_and_improvements_needed.defect: Line 363 unconditionally restarts whole platform via start.ps1 instead of isolated service validation
defects_and_improvements_needed.fix: Make restart optional or controlled via parameter (-RestartPlatform)

defects_and_improvements_needed.defect: Assumes only Qwen 3.8 is served by ik_llama; Ornith also uses ik_llama with mtp:n_max=1,p_min=0.75
defects_and_improvements_needed.fix: Optionally add Ornith test generation to validation matrix
